description: Per-module executed-test floors: 95% of the offline CI population at 707fccb6 (Linux, 2026-10-25), rounded down; bundled four-case SHACL fixture. Full corpus, native and live suites have separate workflow gates. A module with test results but no entry fails the gate. New tests should ratchet these floors.

excluded.rdf/conformance: Its `test` task is the full RDF 1.2 corpus, which CI excludes; conformance.yml and release-readiness.yml gate it with their own floors and the skip allowlist.
